ARM_CFG_GROUPS.BEGIN:
# ARM (Automatic Ripping Machine) config file

#################
## ARM Options ##
#################
ARM_CFG_GROUPS.EMBY_ADDITIONAL: # Parameters to enable automatic library scan in Emby.  This will trigger only if MainFeature is true above.

ARM_NAME:
# Friendly name for this machine.
# Shown in notification titles as [ARM_NAME] when not empty.
# Useful if you run more than one ARM instance.
# Example: Living Room
ARM_CHILDREN:
# Comma-delimited list of child ARM servers to show on the Home page.
# Each entry must be a full URL including protocol and port.
# Example: http://192.168.0.100:8080/
# Child job lists require a login cookie on that host, or DISABLE_LOGIN true on the child.
# CORS is limited to these URLs (not a wildcard).
PREVENT_99:
# Workaround for DVD Track-99 DRM (fake titles that confuse HandBrake).
# Options: true, false
# true: abort the job when 99 tracks are detected (disc is not ripped).
# false: continue and pass the disc to MakeMKV, which can hang or crash on some discs.
ARM_CHECK_UDF:
# Distinguish UDF video discs from UDF data discs by mounting the disc first.
# Options: true, false
# true adds a few seconds to identify but avoids treating a data disc as video.
UMASK:
# Intended umask for files created in RAW_PATH, TRANSCODE_PATH, and COMPLETED_PATH.
# Example: 0o002 makes files group-writable.
# ARM does not currently apply this value. Use SET_MEDIA_PERMISSIONS and CHMOD_VALUE instead.
GET_VIDEO_TITLE:
# Look up a title after a DVD/Blu-ray is identified as video.
# Options: true, false
# DVD: crc64 via pydvdid, then ARM's title API, then OMDB or TMDB (see METADATA_PROVIDER).
# Blu-ray: title from BDMV/META/DL/bdmt_eng.xml on the disc, then the same metadata provider.
# false leaves the disc label as the title.
ARM_API_KEY:
# Optional key for submitting titles to the ARM DVD database (Send DVDs to API).
# Leave empty if you do not submit titles.
DISABLE_LOGIN:
# Control whether the web UI requires a login.
# Options: true, false
# true: all pages are public (no login). Do not use on a shared network.
# false: login is required to view jobs and change settings.
# Change the default admin password (admin/password) immediately.
# Restart the ARM UI after changing this.
SKIP_TRANSCODE:
# Keep MakeMKV output as the final files and skip HandBrake/FFmpeg.
# Options: true, false
# true produces the largest, highest-quality files and uses the most storage.
# Works best with RIPMETHOD set to mkv.
# Set EXTRAS_SUB to something other than None if you do not want extra titles discarded.
VIDEOTYPE:
# How ARM classifies a video disc for folders and naming.
# Options: auto, series, movie
# auto: use the metadata provider result (default).
# series or movie: force that type when identification is wrong.
MINLENGTH:
# Minimum title length in seconds. Shorter MakeMKV/HandBrake titles are ignored.
# Default is 600 (10 minutes).
MAXLENGTH:
# Maximum title length in seconds.
# Use 99999 for no practical maximum.
MANUAL_WAIT:
# Pause after identification so you can change the title in the UI.
# Options: true, false
# true only waits when the drive is in Manual mode.
# Auto-mode drives skip this wait even if this is true.
# Wait length is MANUAL_WAIT_TIME seconds.
MANUAL_WAIT_TIME:
# Seconds to wait for a manual title override when MANUAL_WAIT applies.
# Also used as a delay between MakeMKV info calls when MAX_CONCURRENT_MAKEMKVINFO is set.
DATE_FORMAT:
# Python strftime format for dates in ARM and the UI.
# Example: %m-%d-%Y %H:%M:%S
ALLOW_DUPLICATES:
# Allow ripping the same disc title more than once.
# Options: true, false
# false: ARM exits if it recognises the same movie already ripped.
# true is recommended for TV series discs with shared titles.
MAX_CONCURRENT_TRANSCODES:
# Maximum HandBrakeCLI/FFmpeg processes at once.
# 0 disables the limit (unlimited concurrent transcodes).
# Use a small number if your GPU encode slots or CPU cannot keep up.
MAX_CONCURRENT_MAKEMKVINFO:
# Maximum concurrent makemkvcon info processes.
# 0 disables the limit.
# Set to 1 if info calls crash backup/mkv rips. After each info call ARM also waits MANUAL_WAIT_TIME seconds when this is not 0.
DATA_RIP_PARAMETERS:
# Extra arguments passed to dd when copying data discs.
# Example: conv=noerror,sync to ignore read errors, or status=progress to log progress.
# Leave empty for defaults.
METADATA_PROVIDER:
# Online metadata source for movies/shows after local disc identify.
# Options: omdb, tmdb
# omdb: movies and TV (needs OMDB_API_KEY).
# tmdb: movies (needs TMDB_API_KEY).
# You must set the matching API key.
GET_AUDIO_TITLE:
# How to name audio CDs.
# Options: musicbrainz, none
# musicbrainz: query musicbrainz.org for artist/album.
# none (or any other value): leave the disc untitled.
# freecddb is listed in older docs but is not implemented.
RIP_POSTER:
# Copy a DVD jacket poster from the JACKET_P folder when present.
# Options: true, false
# Requires FFmpeg.
AUTO_EJECT:
# Eject the disc when ripping (or the job) is finished.
# Options: true, false
# false leaves the disc in the drive.
UNIDENTIFIED_EJECT:
# Present in some arm.yaml files but not read by current ARM code.
# Disc eject is controlled by AUTO_EJECT.
ABCDE_CONFIG_FILE:
# Path to the abcde.conf used for audio CD rips.
# Docker default: /etc/arm/config/abcde.conf
RAW_PATH:
# Directory for MakeMKV output (also the source for HandBrake/FFmpeg).
# Include a trailing slash.
TRANSCODE_PATH: # Temporary directory for HandBrake/FFmpeg output before files are moved to COMPLETED_PATH.
COMPLETED_PATH: # Final destination for ripped and transcoded files.
EXTRAS_SUB:
# Subfolder name under a movie folder for extra titles.
# Use None to skip extra titles when SKIP_TRANSCODE is true.
# Media-server examples: extras (Plex/Emby extras folder).
LOGPATH: # Directory for log files. Include a trailing slash.
LOGLEVEL:
# Python logging level.
# Options: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL
# INFO is the default. Use DEBUG while troubleshooting.
LOGLIFE:
# Days to keep log files before they are deleted.
# 0 disables automatic deletion.
DBFILE: # Path to the ARM SQLite database file.
WEBSERVER_IP:
# IP the UI binds to / reports.
# Use x.x.x.x to autodetect.
WEBSERVER_PORT: # TCP port for the ARM web UI. Default 8080.
UI_BASE_URL:
# Public URL used in notifications.
# Include protocol and port. Example: http://192.168.0.10:8080
SET_MEDIA_PERMISSIONS:
# After a job finishes, chmod the output files.
# Options: true, false
# Mode comes from CHMOD_VALUE (for example 777).
CHMOD_VALUE:
# Octal permission mode applied when SET_MEDIA_PERMISSIONS is true.
# Example: 777 or 775.
SET_MEDIA_OWNER:
# After a job finishes, chown the output files.
# Options: true, false
# Requires both CHOWN_USER and CHOWN_GROUP to be set to names that exist on this system.
CHOWN_USER: # System username used when SET_MEDIA_OWNER is true.
CHOWN_GROUP: # System group used when SET_MEDIA_OWNER is true.
MAKEMKV_PERMA_KEY: # Purchased MakeMKV key. If set, ARM will not try to update the beta key.
RIPMETHOD:
# MakeMKV rip method.
# Options: mkv, backup, backup_dvd
# mkv: extract MKV titles (used for DVDs, and for Blu-rays unless backup is selected).
# backup: decrypt and copy a Blu-ray filesystem to disk (often more reliable; needed for MAINFEATURE on Blu-ray).
# backup_dvd: force MakeMKV backup-style extract before HandBrake. MakeMKV backup modes apply to Blu-ray discs.
RIPMETHOD_DVD: # Unused placeholder. DVD ripping follows RIPMETHOD (DVDs use the mkv path unless RIPMETHOD is backup_dvd).
RIPMETHOD_BR: # Unused placeholder. Blu-ray ripping follows RIPMETHOD.
MKV_ARGS:
# Extra arguments passed to makemkvcon.
# Examples: --profile=/opt/arm/default.mmcp.xml  or  --debug=-stdout
# Leave empty for MakeMKV defaults.
DELRAWFILES:
# Delete files in RAW_PATH and TRANSCODE_PATH for the job after it completes.
# Options: true, false
HB_PRESET_DVD:
# HandBrake preset name for DVDs.
# Run HandBrakeCLI -z for the full list. Example: HQ 720p30 Surround
HB_PRESET_BD:
# HandBrake preset name for Blu-rays.
# Run HandBrakeCLI -z for the full list. Example: HQ 1080p30 Surround
DEST_EXT:
# File extension for transcoded output.
# Typical options: mkv, mp4
# Should match what your HandBrake/FFmpeg command actually writes.
HANDBRAKE_CLI: # HandBrake binary name/path used for transcoding. Usually HandBrakeCLI.
HANDBRAKE_LOCAL: # HandBrake binary for local processing. Keep the same as HANDBRAKE_CLI unless you offload encodes.
FFMPEG_PRE_FILE_ARGS: # Extra FFmpeg arguments placed before -i input_file. See ffmpeg -h. Used only when USE_FFMPEG is true.
FFMPEG_POST_FILE_ARGS: # Extra FFmpeg arguments placed after -i input_file. Used only when USE_FFMPEG is true.
FFMPEG_CLI: # FFmpeg binary name/path. Used when USE_FFMPEG is true.
FFMPEG_LOCAL: # Local FFmpeg binary. Keep the same as FFMPEG_CLI unless you offload encodes.
USE_FFMPEG:
# Transcode with FFmpeg instead of HandBrake.
# Options: true, false
# This is experimental. false uses HandBrakeCLI.
MAINFEATURE:
# Transcode only the main feature of a movie disc.
# Options: true, false
# Only applied when the disc is identified as a movie.
# Poor fit for TV series. Blu-ray main-feature detection needs RIPMETHOD backup.
# Requires libdvdcss2 for some DVDs.
HB_ARGS_DVD:
# Extra HandBrakeCLI arguments for DVDs, appended to the preset.
# Example: --subtitle scan -F
HB_ARGS_BD:
# Extra HandBrakeCLI arguments for Blu-rays.
# Example: --subtitle scan -F --subtitle-burned --audio-lang-list eng --all-audio
EMBY_REFRESH:
# Trigger an Emby library scan after a successful main-feature rip.
# Options: true, false
# Only runs when MAINFEATURE is also true. Needs Emby server settings below.
EMBY_SERVER: # Emby hostname or IP address. Leave empty to disable Emby integration.
EMBY_CLIENT: # Emby client name sent during API auth. Can be any label, often ARM.
EMBY_DEVICE: # Emby device name sent during API auth. Can be any label.
EMBY_DEVICEID: # Emby device id sent during API auth. Can be any label.
EMBY_USERNAME: # Emby username used to authenticate library scans.
EMBY_USERID: # Emby user id for EMBY_USERNAME. Find it at http://<server>:<port>/Users/Public
EMBY_PASSWORD:
# SHA1 hex of the Emby password (not the plain password).
# Generate with: echo -n your-password | sha1sum | awk '{print $1}'
EMBY_API_KEY: # Emby API key from the Emby dashboard under Advanced / Security.
NOTIFY_RIP:
# Send a notification when the rip stage finishes.
# Options: true, false
NOTIFY_TRANSCODE:
# Send a notification when transcoding finishes.
# Options: true, false
NOTIFY_JOBID:
# Append the job id to notification titles.
# Options: true, false
PB_KEY: # Pushbullet access token. Leave empty to disable Pushbullet.
IFTTT_KEY: # IFTTT Webhooks key. Leave empty to disable IFTTT.
IFTTT_EVENT: # IFTTT Webhooks event name. Used with IFTTT_KEY. Default arm_event.
PO_USER_KEY:
# Pushover user key. Leave empty to disable Pushover.
# Both PO_USER_KEY and PO_APP_KEY are required to send.
PO_APP_KEY: # Pushover application/API token. Required with PO_USER_KEY.
BASH_SCRIPT:
# Optional script run for every notification.
# Invoked as: bash SCRIPT "title" "body"
# Leave empty to disable.
OMDB_API_KEY: # API key from https://omdbapi.com/ used when METADATA_PROVIDER is omdb.
TMDB_API_KEY: # API key from https://www.themoviedb.org/ used when METADATA_PROVIDER is tmdb.
JSON_URL:
# Apprise-style JSON webhook URL for notifications.
# http:// is sent as json:// and https:// as jsons://
# Leave empty to disable.
APPRISE:
# Path to apprise.yaml for extra notification services.
# Leave empty to disable. Docker default is often /etc/arm/config/apprise.yaml
index_refresh:
# How often the Home page polls for job updates, in milliseconds.
# Default 2000 (every 2 seconds).
# Use a larger number if the page feels busy.
use_icons:
# Legacy UI option. Stored as true or false.
# The current interface does not switch between icons and text based on this value.
save_remote_images:
# Legacy UI option. Stored as true or false.
# Intended to copy remote posters locally. The current UI does not apply this setting.
bootstrap_skin:
# Legacy Bootswatch theme name (for example spacelab).
# The current UI always uses the dark gold theme, so changing this has no visible effect.
language:
# Legacy UI language code (for example en).
# The current interface is English only.
database_limit:
# Number of jobs shown per page on History and Database.
# Values over about 175 can make those pages slow or awkward.
notify_refresh:
# How long UI toast notifications stay on screen, in milliseconds.
# Avoid values under 1000. Default is 6500.
